Laura — thanks for the note and helpful questions. Quick responses inline, and I've attached our standard visitor manifest template and a short site-access instructions PDF.

- Badges: please use the attached visitor_manifest_template.csv and return it no later than EOD Fri (Feb 13). We'll pre-print badges and have them at front security for same-day pickup.  
- NDAs/forms: we require our short visitor confidentiality acknowledgement for guests interacting with demos. I'll send a DocuSign link once we receive your manifest; signed copies should be returned before arrival.  
- Demos/network: Redwood will bring demo laptops and we will run demos on an isolated VLAN managed by our network techs. No access to customer internal networks required. If you expect any onsite network access for Acme devices, flag that now so we can pre-approve firewall rules.  
- Check-in: security desk at Building 3, Lobby B. Typical badge issuance time is ~3–5 minutes if the manifest matches IDs. For VIPs we can arrange expedited pickup and an escort.  
- Recording/photo policy: no photos or screen recordings during restricted demo segments; we will mark those sessions clearly. Attendee phones can remain on but must be placed on airplane mode during sensitive segments if requested.

Next steps:  
1) You fill the attached CSV and return to me.
2) I'll issue DocuSign NDA and provide a HubSpot link for the visit record.
3) Marissa will coordinate badge printing & onsite escorting. Connor will lead the network/IT check. Sergio is listed as the senior security contact for escalation.

Point of contact on arrival: Jasmine Liu, +1 (415) 555-0132 (cell).

Thanks — I put a short checklist below for your convenience.

Attached: visitor_manifest_template.csv; redwood_site_access_instructions.pdf

Kind regards,
Jasmine Liu
